items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Somebody told me that Cootie's teacher was Charles Lipscomb. How do you pronounce that name? Is that the man you were telling about? Lipscomb? Lipscomb. That's right.

ctx.x: Did he play with you too? Yes, Cootie played with me quite a bit. Back he started right out playing with me right here in Mobile. Somebody once... I went to New York one time and he and Duke Ellington, they wanted me to play in his band. Oh really? As I told him about that time, I was less too old now. I couldn't compete with those fellows in the bank of that band. Those bands. Yes, Cootie played with me quite a while.
Somebody told me that Cootie's teacher was Charles Lipscomb. How do you pronounce that name? Is that the man you were telling about? Lipscomb? Lipscomb. That's right.

Give all the information. Make it honest now while you're in. I'm calling. I don't. Good. Looked like you brought your band. So I says, the seltzer band. So I put it in the announcement. I says, the seltzer band's going to play. So then I asked one of the men, I says, now what's this seltzer band? They said, the men always say, well, that's the excelsior band. The seltzer band. So that's another phase of your evening.
